result.title: Structure-preserving fidelity diagnostics for partial differential equations
result.summary: Machine learning surrogates of partial differential equations (PDEs) are commonly trained on data generated by numerical solvers. Therefore, the training data obey not the PDE but the modified equation of the numerical scheme, and the test loss, computed on data from the same solver, cannot distinguish a model that learned the physics from one that learned the discretization error. Here, we show that the difference is nevertheless visible in the trained model. We propose a suite of structure-preserving fidelity diagnostics, simple scores that measure whether a learned model respects one known property of the physics, such as a conserved quantity, a symmetry or a Hamiltonian structure, without access to the training data or the governing equation. Over five systems, the diagnostics track the error with respect to the true dynamics with a rank correlation of up to $0.94$, while the test loss is uncorrelated or anti-correlated with it. For the Burgers, Korteweg-de Vries and Navier-Stokes equations, the diagnostics separate numerical schemes that the test loss ranks as equivalent, including schemes of the same order. order.

AI.brief_summary: 论文为 PDE 的机器学习代理模型提出一组「结构保持保真度诊断」评分，在无法访问训练数据或控制方程的条件下，通过检验模型是否尊重守恒量、对称性或哈密顿结构等已知物理性质，来区分模型学到的是物理还是数值格式的离散化误差。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「不依赖数据与真值、只检验模型是否满足已知不变量」的评测思路，可能为 LVR 中判断 latent 状态是否保留任务必要信息（如几何与实体关系）、以及脱离训练分布评价表示保真度提供启发，属较远领域的评价方法线索，迁移可行性可供核查。
